problem_statement: validate_safe_url() can be bypassed by attacker-controlled hostnames when LANGCHAIN_ENV is set to local_test, and the allowed-hosts logic over-matches on environment variable prefixes, creating an SSRF vector.
target_user: Security engineers hardening LangChain deployments that accept user-influenced URLs.

user_stories.action: trust that validate_safe_url() blocks SSRF even under local_test configuration
user_stories.value: I can deploy without a hidden bypass that only appears in certain env states

acceptance_criteria.given: LANGCHAIN_ENV is local_test and an attacker-controlled hostname is supplied
acceptance_criteria.then: the URL is rejected rather than passed through

acceptance_criteria.given: an allowed-hosts entry that is a prefix of an attacker hostname
acceptance_criteria.then: the match requires an exact host boundary and does not over-match on prefix

success_metrics.name: SSRF bypass closure
success_metrics.definition: whether the known local_test bypass and prefix over-match are both closed by a regression test

risks.description: A stricter host match could break legitimate subdomain use cases that relied on prefix matching
